Run JavaScript that calls cmux tools and return its result: an async function body, `await cmux.<tool>({...})` per call, `return` a JSON value. Do related steps in one script: look up, act and check together. No file system, network or timers; console.log comes back in logs.

Common tools (no docs search needed):
- workspace_list, workspace_get, pane_list {workspace}, tab_list {pane | workspace}, terminal_list, terminal_get: ids and names. Lists answer {items: [...]}; a change answers {value: {...}} with the new ids (value.terminal_id, value.pane_id, value.tab_id).
- tab_create_terminal {shell, name}: with no pane, the terminal opens on the person's right, as a tab in the column right of this chat, or a new column when there is none. Use it for 'open a terminal', 'run X on my right', 'next to my logs'.
- pane_split {pane, direction, shell}: only when the person asks for a split. A pane or tab started with shell closes when that command exits; to keep the output, start a shell and type the command with terminal_input_write.
- terminal_input_write {terminal, text: "cmd\n"}; terminal_wait {terminal, pattern, timeout_ms} waits for text (never sleep or poll); terminal_screen_read and terminal_history_read {terminal} read it.
- tab_rename {tab, name}, tab_close {tab}, tab_focus {tab}; workspace_rename {workspace, name}.
- Groups: tab_group_create {tabs: [ids], name}; workspace_group_create {name}, then workspace_place {workspace, group: <its id>} for each member.
- workspace_status_set {workspace, key, text} (a sidebar status pill); notification_create {title, body}.

Anything else: `await cmux.docs("words")` answers {tools: [{name, description, inputSchema}], more: [names]}; a tool's exact name finds it first. app_* tools are the app's menu actions. A failed call throws an Error whose `cmux` field has the error, its state and its idempotency key; its message names the fix. A failed script reports the calls that already ran.
